lines: Safe <pulse>travels</pulse>. Come by whenever you like.
Take your time out there. I will be glad to see you again.
<pulse>Catch you later</pulse>. Keep safe on the road.
Do not wander too far without a good meal in you.
Good talking with you. Truly.
May the road treat you kindly.
You have a steady step today. Hold onto that.
I have plenty waiting on me, but I <green>enjoyed</green> this.
Thanks for stopping a while. It is good to share the time.
Until <pulse>next time</pulse>, walk easy and keep a <wave>warm</wave> fire nearby.
Until next time.
That will do for now, I think.
We can speak again another day.
I have a few things to finish.
I appreciate the talk.
<pulse>Take care</pulse>. Come back when you need something.
That is enough chatter for now.
Thank you for the time.
I will be around, if you need me.
Be well until we meet again.
That is enough for now.
We are finished here.
I have said enough.
Let us <pulse>not drag this out</pulse>.
I am done for today.
This conversation is over.
No more words. Not now.
We can leave this for another time.
I need some distance.
This is where we stop.
Please, let me go now.
That is all I know. Please do not hurt me.
I answered you. I am going somewhere safe now.
Please keep your distance while I leave.
We are done, yes? <shake>I need to go.</shake>
I cannot keep talking while I am this afraid.
Please leave peacefully. That is all I ask.
I need to get back where other people can see me.
That is everything. Please let that be enough.
I am leaving now. Please do not follow me.
<jump>Bye!</jump> Come back later!
Bye! You can visit again.
Goodbye! I am going to <pulse>play</pulse> now.
See you later!
Alright, I am off to run and <jump>jump</jump>!
Come back when you are done with your game.
I will be here when you come back.
Goodbye! Do not be gone too long.
Okay, I am going to do something fun now.
Go on now. I will see you soon!
Okay. Goodbye.
Okay. I am <pulse>done</pulse> talking now.
Goodbye. I am going over there.
Goodbye now. I need to stay busy.
Okay, I am done for a while.
I am going to the other side of the square.
I will see you again soon. Maybe.
Alright, that is all.
Time to go do my chores.
Goodbye! I am heading <wave>over there</wave> now.
I am going to find someone <pulse>older</pulse>.
I am going back where it feels safer.
I need to find a grown-up now.
I am heading somewhere safer.
I think I should stay close to people I trust.
I am going to the grown-ups' side now.
I do not want to be alone right now.
I am leaving so I can breathe easier.
I will come back when I feel braver.
I am going where the crowd is.
